original_test_intent: In an approved known system configuration, obtain the complete AMD-SMI CPU/GPU topology and prove that device indices and topology relationships match the platform recipe without command errors.
original_method: Capture SUT, CPU/NUMA, PCIe, GPU, driver/firmware and AMD-SMI identities; validate the approved package/version, collect complete untruncated amd-smi topology output and exit status, independently inventory CPU/GPU/PCIe/NUMA state, normalize each device-index relationship against the owner recipe and preserve discrepancies/logs without changing platform state.
manual_activity: The owner supplies and approves the known recipe, expected map and compatible AMD-SMI; an operator reviews the normalized topology diff; the owner dispositions any enumeration difference and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Approved platform/system and BIOS configuration recipe
Compatible AMD-SMI/amdsmi package and driver/kernel version
Policy for allowed device-index reordering, unsupported fields and no-error acceptance
safety_requirements: Use protected authenticated access and redact secrets
Do not clear logs or install unapproved packages
Do not reset/rebind GPUs or change BIOS, driver, power or enumeration state
Collect full output without grep/head truncation and retain exit status
Correlate with independent identity inventory from the same SUT/time window
Stop on error, incomplete output, missing/duplicate identity or unexplained topology difference
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only identities and independent PCIe/CPU/NUMA/GPU inventory
Validate installed AMD-SMI version and compatibility
Run complete topology command and normalize each relationship to supplied recipe
Perform no recipe invention, package/state mutation, remediation or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve known configuration, compatible package and expected topology oracle
Decide whether any device-index reordering or unsupported field is acceptable
Disposition discrepancies and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: amd-smi topology is the correct core read, but insecure transport and absence of package/version, identity and expected-map comparison make the proposed evidence insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the approved AMD-SMI topology command through protected access, retain complete output/exit status and compare an identity-normalized map with independent PCIe/NUMA inventory and the owner recipe.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Known configuration, amd-smi topology, no-error goal, no bundle and 10/10-minute values remain; the acceptance oracle must be supplied.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare raw AMD-SMI topology and independent CPU/NUMA/PCIe/GPU inventory through stable hardware identities rather than device indices alone.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the implicit known-configuration comparison explicit and secure without adding state changes.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No stderr does not detect a complete but wrong socket, NUMA, GPU or device-index mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Device indices may legitimately reorder across enumeration; only an owner-approved stable-identity map can distinguish acceptable reorder from wiring/topology failure.

project_override_considerations: If device indices are intentionally non-stable, compare BDF/serial/socket relationships and record the approved normalization. Missing recipe or compatible package makes execution pending, not an inferred pass.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and raw-command acceptance gap
Complete amd-smi topology output, exit status and timestamps
Independent inventory and identity-normalized per-device topology comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source names a known configuration but provides no expected topology or definition for 'No show error' and asks to clear logs. DeepSeek treats raw command success as sufficient, uses insecure access and omits package/driver compatibility and independent identity comparison.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; approved AMD-SMI, recipe/map, protected access and inventory tools are supplyable project inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2056 Wistron-AMD SVM-00010-V002: approve the system/BIOS recipe, compatible AMD-SMI/driver/kernel version, authoritative CPU/socket/NUMA/GPU/BDF-to-device-index topology map and the policy for index reordering, unsupported fields, missing/duplicate relationships and 'No show error' acceptance.

review_improvement: Converts a raw command dump into a package- and identity-bound topology comparison with a traceable owner oracle.
independent_technical_reasoning: Topology output can be syntactically successful while mapping a GPU to the wrong socket or omitting a device. Numeric AMD-SMI indices are enumeration artifacts, so stable BDF/serial/socket identity must anchor the comparison and independent inventory must establish completeness. Since the source does not contain the expected map, automation may collect and compare only after the owner provides that oracle; it cannot declare a DUT pass from exit code alone.
